title: Revision-bound authority and source census
goal: Resolve and pin exact main, PR101, PR784 and global identity/product-kind authority, with observed vs uninspected evidence.
acceptance: Revision manifest binds full SHAs | every consequential finding points to owner and source | missing sources remain UNKNOWN.
negative_controls: Stale SHA must not qualify as current.

title: Admit full-cutover decision to working plan
goal: Capture operator instruction: no historical transport, auth, data or migration compatibility; no second Memory authority.
acceptance: Current plan declares oauth native HTTP only and no stdio/signed-agent/static bearer fallback | prior campaign record retained immutable.
negative_controls: Old stdio or signed-agent paths cannot be treated as required compatibility.

title: Supersede conflicting legacy ADRs explicitly
goal: Record a new dated superseding ADR rather than rewriting historical ADR decisions into apparent original intent.
acceptance: New ADR explicitly supersedes transport/auth/client provisions of ADR-038, ADR-082, ADR-083, ADR-098, and ADR-064 where applicable | all ten AGENTS invariants preserved or amendment approved by owner.
negative_controls: No accepted ADR may still require a live Memory stdio door.

title: Reconfirm Memory Dependency hosted-service exception
goal: Use the already admitted product-kind exception instead of inventing a new node or Gate route.
acceptance: Topology explicitly binds l9.product-kind-exception/memory-hosted-service@1 and service runtime identity | no ConstellationIdentity asserted.

title: Identity dimensions and provenances contract
goal: Distinguish product, release, runtime, actor, surface, constellation applicability, and nonidentity OAuth principal claims.
acceptance: Every field has a canonical owner, evidence input and unknown/invalid policy | auth never treated as authorship or surface attestation.
negative_controls: An OAuth client_id alone cannot prove execution surface or agent authorship.

title: Threat model native OAuth agent/machine distinction
goal: Prove user/client authentication does not silently claim agent actor or mobile-specific surface; prohibit prompt-controlled identity.
acceptance: Threat model covers stolen token, client-ID spoofing, false surface, cross-tenant authorization, admin escalation, replay, token exchange and revocation.
negative_controls: Unsigned headers and user input cannot promote unknown ActorIdentity to resolved.

title: No-legacy-data cutover disposition
goal: Preserve operator-confirmed old SQLite backup and narrowly authorized legacy Memory retirement while requiring a fresh isolated PostgreSQL 16 database.
acceptance: No unapproved migration or import of old Memory/Neo4j | fresh database lifecycle and rollback policy distinguish pre-first-write from post-first-write.
negative_controls: Backup attestation is not misrepresented as independently reverified | no Graphiti/Neo4j deletion.

title: Cross-repository ownership / PR disposition
goal: Memory owns server, protocol, policy, package and carrier; Cursor-Governance consumes canonical identity projection and native client config; l9-deploy owns hosting and release.
acceptance: PR101 remains carrier candidate until OAuth retarget | PR784 remains consumer candidate until native endpoint and actor provenance proof | no new identity registry.
negative_controls: No second MCP gateway or OAuth server inside Cursor-Governance.

title: Source coverage census and audit closure routing
goal: Recover original 144-module ledger, which was not attached, and rerun targeted missing large-file source census with line ranges.
acceptance: Every one of 20 confirmed and nine unresolved concerns classified | uninspected code remains explicitly NOT_REVIEWED | discoveries fed back as new nodes.
negative_controls: Do not declare whole-codebase audit complete from 36 fully read files.

title: Obsolete documentation, examples, configuration inventory
goal: Remove or rewrite active documentation that instructs users to launch Memory stdio, use signed agent keys or migrate legacy SQLite, without erasing archived ADR history.
acceptance: All actively advertised setup paths show native OAuth HTTP only | historical source docs archived and marked superseded | docs/CLI examples tested.
negative_controls: No README or quickstart yields stdio or static bearer config.
source_paths: README.md | QUICKSTART.md | ARCHITECTURE.md | SECURITY.md | MIGRATION.md | docs/CURSOR_INSTANTIATION.md | config/memory.yaml.example

title: Material compatibility break and fresh release semantic identity
goal: Use exact source and artifact digests; version remains only a candidate until admitted. No implicit 2.x upgrade/migration or same package meaning.
acceptance: Version, manifest, upgrade refusal and changelog agree on no legacy reader/importer promise | no unearned product-release claim.

title: Independent plan admission and source closure
goal: Submit this working graph with executed receipts to owner; graph cannot self-admit or authorize code/publication.
acceptance: Strategy owner and independent assurance accept exact graph revision separately from the product release.

title: Auth0 tenant resource-parameter and client proof
goal: Verify Auth0 Resource Parameter Compatibility Profile, API audience, RFC8707 resource, client registration and target Claude/Cursor behavior before coding an assumption.
acceptance: Real PKCE authorization produces aud-bound access token for Memory resource and expected scope | no userinfo-audience fallback.
negative_controls: resource mismatch or third-party client denied aud must fail release.

title: OAuth protected resource metadata (RFC9728)
goal: Advertise one resource and one authorized issuer from native Memory endpoint with correct WWW-Authenticate metadata pointer.
acceptance: /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource serves valid resource, authorization_servers, scopes | unauthenticated /mcp challenges with resource_metadata.
negative_controls: Incorrect resource URI and unreachable AS metadata rejected.

title: Authorization-server discovery and client metadata contract
goal: Consume Auth0 OIDC / RFC8414 discovery; do not synthesize a second issuer or brittle authorization endpoint rewriting.
acceptance: Issuer, authorization endpoint, JWKS, PKCE and client registration behavior validated against real tenant | CIMD supported or controlled static registration documented.
negative_controls: Mismatched discovery issuer blocks server startup.

title: Native resource server middleware
goal: Install upstream OAuth-compatible MCP SDK security layer where adequate; server enforces auth before dispatch.
acceptance: Authenticated caller is verified per request by one middleware | no client-controlled claims or custom signed headers | SDK gap documented if library insufficient.
negative_controls: Anonymous, invalid and wrong-resource requests refused.

title: Cryptographic token verification JWKS/JWT
goal: Verify issuer, exact audience, signature/alg allowlist, kid, exp, nbf, freshness and key rotation from Auth0.
acceptance: Forged, expired, not-yet-valid, tampered, wrong issuer, wrong audience, unsupported alg tokens all rejected before reaching tools.
negative_controls: alg none, kid confusion, wrong aud, invalid nbf, issuer alias all denied.

title: OAuth scopes, tool risk and resource binding
goal: Enforce least-privilege scopes for read, write, maintain and administrator workflows above namespace policy.
acceptance: Scope refusal is distinct from missing namespace grant | admin/high-risk tools require independently authorized privileged channel.
negative_controls: Read token cannot mutate, admin operation cannot be obtained with ordinary tool scope.

title: Auth0 client registrations for Claude and Cursor
goal: Register distinct, narrow client identities or CIMD with explicit Auth0 controls; refuse uncontrolled DCR.
acceptance: Claude and Cursor integrations authenticate through provider-managed OAuth with distinct verified authorization context | PKCE and redirect URIs grounded in actual clients.
negative_controls: Unapproved DCR clients must not acquire Memory privileges.

title: Server-derived principal and namespace grants
goal: Derive principal, tenant, organization, workspace, user and roles from verified issuer/subject and server policy, not request.
acceptance: All tool paths reuse one MemoryPrincipal | tenant and namespace maps on server | cross-tenant refusals verified.
negative_controls: Payload-submitted user_id/tenant_id/scope does not override grants.

title: ActorIdentity source and assurance binding
goal: Apply global identity projection and verified credential-context mapping without assigning actor purely from public OAuth client_id.
acceptance: Consequential agent memory write has validated actor coordinate/evidence binding or fails closed | authenticated user and actor remain separate.
negative_controls: Caller-supplied actor, JWT client_id alone, or projected profile cannot establish author.

title: SurfaceIdentity evidence and Unknown discipline
goal: Resolve Cursor/Claude surface only when trustworthy specific evidence is present, otherwise preserve unknown; no automatic Claude desktop/mobile relabel.
acceptance: One identity assertion records surface independently from actor | all receipts/tags reflect resolved or explicit Unknown consistently.
negative_controls: Account-level Claude connector is not per-request proof of mobile origin.

title: Memory ProductIdentity, ReleaseIdentity, RuntimeIdentity proof
goal: Bind service product coordinate, exact admitted wheel/container release, and C1 deployment instance to records/operational receipts.
acceptance: Product stable, release digest-locked, runtime deployment-identified | one does not stand in for another | Unknown blocks consequential release provenance.
negative_controls: Environment label, package version alone, or container name not sufficient release evidence.

title: Constellation identity explicit non-applicability
goal: Memory is a hosted Dependency exception; no Constellation identity is invented or Gate routing required.
acceptance: Identity assertion marks constellation inapplicable separately from Unknown | tests enforce exact product-kind exception.
negative_controls: No synthetic l9-constellation id or Gate grant.

title: One complete evidence-bound identity assertion
goal: Unify caller Actor/Surface and service Product/Release/Runtime coordinates without conflating caller and service runtime.
acceptance: Typed receipt lists applicability, value/Unknown, authority, evidence refs, resolver and governing revision, consistent across MCP tools, hooks and logs.
negative_controls: Missing, conflicting or stale assertion refuses consequential operations.

title: Token, grant and JWKS revocation/rotation
goal: Define bounded JWKS cache, refresh and old-key refusal; do not treat Infisical reload as completed authenticator refresh.
acceptance: Key rotation, permission withdrawal and replay across resource audience have measured behavior | no stale grants after required bound.
negative_controls: Removed grant cannot continue writing after refresh boundary.

title: Remove signed-agent, static bearer, human stdio HTTP doors
goal: Delete legacy authentication and its environmental proof path from shipped server and client implementations.
acceptance: No live server auth mode other than OAuth resource server | no HMAC agent headers, static Bearer principal map, or local auth-disabled HTTP bypass on externally exposed service.
negative_controls: Old signed-agent request and long-lived static bearer fail closed.

title: Operator/admin workflow separated from agent OAuth
goal: Keep privileged maintenance/deletion safe while eliminating stdio human secret doors; use separately authenticated and audited narrow operator authorization.
acceptance: Admin-only tools have explicit remote or administrative operator path, no default admin, and server side tenant boundaries | file-system tools require local secure operation.
negative_controls: No ordinary Claude/Cursor OAuth grant can read arbitrary C1 filesystem or become admin.

title: No token exfiltration, logs or config persistence
goal: Prove authenticated headers and server credentials are never echoed, logged or stored in generated client config; keep Infisical server-side only.
acceptance: CI secret-scan and hosted logs show token redaction | no user pasted bearer/HMAC credentials in native client config.
negative_controls: Invalid request cannot reflect Authorization header.

title: Pin supported native MCP protocol revisions
goal: Probe installed Claude and Cursor clients against server protocols and pin only revisions they demonstrably negotiate.
acceptance: Negotiation and tool listing pass for each target | unsupported revision yields explicit refusal, no fake compatibility.
negative_controls: No pretending to serve a revision whose required features are absent.

title: Native MCP SDK/transport selection
goal: Reuse a well-maintained Python MCP SDK for Streamable HTTP and its auth extensions, reducing handcrafted wire logic; identify gaps before selection.
acceptance: One transport implementation and one tool registry | no additional API sidecar | SDK version pinned and negative conformance run.
negative_controls: No proxy or bespoke auth server compensating for an inadequate SDK silently.

title: Eliminate stdio MCP endpoint, launcher and advertised installers
goal: Remove Memory stdio process entry, stdio MCP server mode, SSE compatibility alias and stdio client installer/verify paths.
acceptance: Fresh install exposes only OAuth HTTP MCP remote surface | no .mcp.json command/args entry | removed stdio test fixtures replaced by negative legacy-path tests.
negative_controls: Memory stdio cannot be selected with old flags or setup wrappers.

title: UnknownTool vs invalid-argument error dispatch
goal: Separate method/tool dispatch error from missing fields, so -32601 never swallows KeyError in handlers (F-003).
acceptance: Missing namespace/purpose -> -32602 Invalid params | unknown method/tool -> -32601 | remote clients classify correctly.
negative_controls: Missing argument cannot trigger CONTRACT_MISMATCH.

title: MCP tool-result envelope and client exceptions
goal: RemoteMemoryClient and any retained TypeScript client must surface tool isError and JSON-RPC errors as typed failures.
acceptance: Neither Python nor TS client treats isError:true as a successful write | no catch-all success JSON conversion.
negative_controls: Tool text Error: cannot become successful output.

title: Bounded executor offload on HTTP handler edge
goal: Keep synchronous MemoryService; offload blocking store/provider/readiness to bounded worker pool, preserve contextvars and per-thread DB safety.
acceptance: Two-second slow tool does not block healthz | 99p responsiveness cap measured in finite test | backpressure limits finite and explicit.
negative_controls: Unbounded threads or event loop blocking fail.

title: Healthz/readiness reflect real selected capabilities
goal: Probe canonical Postgres and selected projection/graph services separately, never return static true readiness on failure.
acceptance: Healthz remains responsive | readyz 503 for required store unavailable | disabled optional family is not interpreted as healthy active.
negative_controls: Unreachable canonical database must never report ready=true.

title: Streamable HTTP protocol and transport negative suite
goal: Validate origin, version, headers, size, JSON-RPC envelopes, notification semantics and 401 PRM challenge against current negotiated specs.
acceptance: One /mcp endpoint, protocol checks and auth before dispatch | no docs/openapi exposure without deliberate policy.
negative_controls: Batch, missing content-type, malicious Origin, token URL, unauthenticated docs denied.

title: Native Python client OAuth and result semantics
goal: Retain Python remote client as OAuth resource consumer only if it has active use; remove custom per-agent signed header support.
acceptance: Client uses provider/native token grant and refresh | strict error classification | no HMAC or raw bearer setting committed.
negative_controls: Expired token or 403 cannot downgrade to local stdio.

title: Retain/retire TypeScript SDK with explicit scope
goal: Prove actual consumer for TypeScript remote client; if retained, OAuth only; otherwise remove from release without compatibility shim.
acceptance: Exactly one supported TypeScript path or explicit retired package with no false support claim.
negative_controls: No static token fallback marketed as agent authentication.

title: MCP tool inventory and legacy alias trim
goal: Keep canonical current tool names, remove deprecated aliases/old transport-coupled tools without keeping parser shims.
acceptance: Tool listing matches one approved contract and strict JSON-schema field semantics | removed names explicitly unavailable.
negative_controls: Old aliases not silently routed to new writes.

title: Installed-wheel and true TCP PostgreSQL contract
goal: Run actual installed wheel HTTP server with OAuth issuer test fixture and PostgreSQL 16, not only in-memory TestClient.
acceptance: Add/get/search/write/read/restart and auth negatives pass on exact wheel | STDIO mode cannot launch.
negative_controls: SQLite fallback and unsigned tool writes refused.

title: Prevent ambiguous integer PII corruption
goal: Fix F-010 redaction of Unix epochs and numeric ticket identifiers without losing detection of true phone/SSN.
acceptance: Integer epochs and nine-digit IDs persist accurately or receive explicit ambiguity outcome | true formatted phone/SSN sanitized per policy.
negative_controls: 1761573600 and 123456789 must not silently collapse to placeholders.

title: Ambiguous PII policy explicit quarantine or evidence
goal: Handle indistinguishable unformatted phone/identifier through policy and meaningful warnings, not silent preservation or silent replacement.
acceptance: Ambiguous values are quarantined or require declarative context | redaction confidence recorded as evidence.
negative_controls: Unformatted genuine phone cannot be unconditionally exempted.

title: Normalized content, digest and provenance integrity
goal: Bind redacted normalized text and source digest to provenance with clear lossless/changed status and collision prevention.
acceptance: Different operational epochs yield distinguishable canonical normalized content/digests | original digest before transformation preserved.
negative_controls: Different source content with distinct accepted semantics cannot share redacted digest silently.

title: Explicit evidence cannot be fabricated by MCP
goal: Transport provenance is not EvidenceKind.EXPLICIT and does not prove human consent.
acceptance: Sensitive identity/preference request without independent explicit evidence is REJECTED regardless of authenticated connector.
negative_controls: Authenticated write alone cannot mint explicit sensitive evidence.

title: Purpose-bound consent semantics and timestamps
goal: Resolve U-012 policy on consent.granted_at vs valid_from, preserving time semantics and requiring actual subject authorization.
acceptance: Typed consent with subject/class/namespace/purpose/issued/expiry checked at documented event time | past valid_from treated deliberately, not now by accident.
negative_controls: Wrong subject, class, purpose, namespace or time cannot be admitted.

title: End-to-end sensitive admission negative matrix
goal: Integrate normalization, explicit evidence, consent and canonical store test through native MCP and direct SDK.
acceptance: A valid authorized sensitive request admits | invalid sensitive requests reject without persisted record | warnings/receipts consistent.
negative_controls: No bypass through memory.write_agent, ingest, write_governed or generated-data.

title: Namespace and local privilege threat closure
goal: Resolve U-005/U-010 in context of OAuth-only public HTTP: no Tier-3 fallback; server grants remain explicit.
acceptance: No request or env-only string widens namespace permissions in remote OAuth server | local CLI admin isolated to operator policy.
negative_controls: Remote unauthenticated requests cannot claim arbitrary namespaces or admin.

title: Memory guard hostile shell default-deny
goal: Eliminate permissive regex bypass by default-denying shell without evidence or using a parser that rejects substitutions/newlines/write flags.
acceptance: ls $(...), multiline rm, git log --output and find -fprint all denied | read-only commands accepted only under strict contract.
negative_controls: No shell substitution or output-write flags escape gate.

title: Adapter candidate-window and retrieval parity
goal: Unify candidate-window multiplier across test in-memory adapter and PostgreSQL production; no Sqlite production parity obligation.
acceptance: Planner and adapters share named constant | same fixture yields same candidate set after normalization.
negative_controls: Limit*10 vs limit*20 divergence detected.

title: Generated-data capabilities are evidence-derived
goal: Remove hard-coded store_ready/ready=True and use actual health/readiness.
acceptance: Unhealthy required canonical store yields false readiness and failed capability proof.
negative_controls: Static true returns forbidden.

title: Pin Graphiti add_memory tool schema and metadata semantics
goal: Use the exact versioned Graphiti MCP server to verify add_memory/add_episode schema, result isError and accepted response shape.
acceptance: Schema contract test proves passed parameters are supported | unsupported metadata is translated or rejected explicitly.
negative_controls: Provider rejects unknown metadata and no phantom success occurs.

title: Honor MCP tool isError on all Graphiti responses
goal: Parse result envelope isError before content text/JSON unwrapping, preserving diagnostics and typed error kind.
acceptance: isError true always raises ProjectionError and returns no success envelope.
negative_controls: MCP Error: text never accepted as success.

title: Distinguish provider semantic and availability faults
goal: Classify JSON-RPC invalid params, unknown tools, provider application errors and transport faults correctly before updating breaker.
acceptance: -32602 does not increment circuit failure | network/availability failures do | policy for -32000 class documented.
negative_controls: Five invalid-param calls must not open an otherwise healthy provider circuit.

title: Half-open probe timeout recovery and single-probe rule
goal: Fix half-open state machine so an unreported probe expires and later recovery is permitted without unbounded probes.
acceptance: OPEN->HALF_OPEN->failed or stuck probe->OPEN->recover after timeout | at most one active probe until expiry.
negative_controls: Breaker never remains HALF_OPEN forever after missing report.

title: Session handshake failures settle breaker state
goal: Ensure initialize/notifications/expired-session retry exceptions report breaker outcome exactly once.
acceptance: Failing _ensure_session records failure and resets session | recovered endpoint can reconnect without process restart.
negative_controls: Failed handshake must not consume one permanent half-open permit.

title: Positive provider acceptance required for projection link
goal: Allow name-based locators only after verified successful write acceptance; preserve async-ingestion distinction and provider read-after-write verification.
acceptance: No provider failure can create ProjectionLink or DELIVERED | successful acceptance may create locator with explicit pending-ingest evidence.
negative_controls: String Error result and ambiguous response cannot synthesize locator.

title: Outbox integrated isError and erase proof
goal: Run fake Graphiti MCP isError integration through transport->adapter->outbox->store.
acceptance: Failed project event retries/deadletters and no link | deletion of never-successfully-projected record does not require nonexistent provider copy.
negative_controls: No DELIVERED or deletion DEAD from a fabricated locator.

title: Reconcile pre-existing phantom links safely
goal: Detect candidate legacy phantom links from past faulty projection runs without declaring unverified provider absence as proved.
acceptance: Inventory with durable audit receipt | repair/queue re-projection only after provider confirmation and governed operator permission.
negative_controls: No blind deletion, no false verified-erasure receipt.

title: Graphiti provider call idempotency and duplicate episodes
goal: Prove retries and lease expiry cannot leak duplicate provider copies; use stable scope-safe idempotency or exhaustive locator reconciliation.
acceptance: Two workers with expired lease converge to one logical obligation | orphan episodes counted and cleaned with proof.
negative_controls: Provider UUID locator cannot strand a second duplicate episode.

title: Graphiti real provider qualification in isolated scope
goal: Use disposable provider graph/namespace, not protected C1 Graphiti/Neo4j episodes, for true add-search-delete/retry proof.
acceptance: Exact pinned Graphiti version, tool schema, episode listing, deletion and async-ingest convergence recorded | no protected tenant mutations.
negative_controls: Tool-returned accepted without eventual episode confirmation cannot be called integrated projection success.

title: Explicit Zep disposition: retire or qualify, no automatic fallback
goal: Decide whether Zep has an admitted current consumer; default retire if none, otherwise qualify F-014/F-017 under separate provider contract.
acceptance: Decision receipt selects one path, package and tests agree | inactive optional Zep cannot claim ready.
negative_controls: No hidden automatic provider fallback.

title: If retained, Zep delivered bytes equal digested bytes
goal: Eliminate body[:10000] silent truncation; reject oversized writes or implement explicitly versioned faithful chunk projection.
acceptance: Digest attests exactly delivered bytes and legacy JSON never gets malformed by truncation.
negative_controls: No silent truncation of >10000 characters.

title: If retained, Zep readiness probes real reachability
goal: A fresh Zep transport health() must probe connectivity, not rely on last traffic result.
acceptance: Ready is truthful on a newly started ACTIVE target and false on outage.
negative_controls: No ACTIVE provider deadlock before first traffic.

title: Projection provider target manifest and activation gate
goal: Enforce explicit selected target manifests, scope and transport readiness; graph/vector optionality never weakens canonical readiness.
acceptance: Graphiti capability activated only after real provider suite | no optional provider family is inferred healthy or mandatory for base store.
negative_controls: No Graphiti activation on fake tests or unresolved locator race.

title: Complete canonical mutation method and bypass census
goal: Inspect RecordStore mutations in Postgres, in-memory, outbox, maintenance; classify canonical vs worker operational metadata.
acceptance: Every consequential mutation has an explicit capability and service owner or a narrowly justified and admitted exception | scanner complete.
negative_controls: Direct complete_deletion or link/receipt mutation cannot bypass service law.

title: Service-owned outbox result application
goal: Outbox worker performs provider operations but submits evidence to narrow MemoryService methods for canonical link, lifecycle and receipt commits.
acceptance: No second control plane | worker cannot mint arbitrary capability | service issues and validates write scope.
negative_controls: Bypass scanner disallows worker direct canonical status transitions.

title: Lease-aware atomic projection link and delivery settle
goal: Bind active record check, current lease owner CAS, accepted provider evidence, link upsert and DELIVERED event in one Postgres transaction.
acceptance: Losing lease cannot install any durable link or DELIVERED status | link and outcome commit atomically after acceptance.
negative_controls: Worker with expired lease cannot install link even if record ACTIVE.

title: Provider side effects compensable across lost leases
goal: A failed atomic link/settle after a successful external provider write needs durable compensation or idempotency, never abandon an orphan.
acceptance: Compensation work is persisted/recoverable and eventually removes extra provider episode | closed if provider unavailable only as pending.
negative_controls: Process kill after provider acceptance cannot cause silently forgotten episode.

title: Atomic retirement link/receipt/outbox settlement
goal: After verified provider retirement, withdraw link and write ADR-076 receipt in same Postgres transaction with current lease.
acceptance: No possible transaction state with removed link and missing retirement receipt | event cannot be DELIVERED without receipt.
negative_controls: Crash between link removal and receipt persists neither or both.

title: Retirement retries are idempotent and audit-preserving
goal: Ensure retries after accepted provider delete converge to same retirement receipt, avoiding a no-op when link withdrawn.
acceptance: Repeated event yields same proof and does not overwrite original retirement reason or stamp a false new event.
negative_controls: No project_retire_noop can erase an owed receipt.

title: Verified deletion completion requires capability
goal: Route complete_deletion via MemoryService-issued service capability and require no remaining projections.
acceptance: Any direct adapter.complete_deletion without capability is refused by all supported stores | deletion completion writes once.
negative_controls: No API can append DELETED status outside service authorization.

title: Idempotent deletion receipt and status replay
goal: Guarantee complete_deletion of an already deleted record does not duplicate events or mutate original completed_at.
acceptance: Repeat on same receipt is byte-stable or documented idempotent | differing receipt cannot rewrite original authority.
negative_controls: Two completed events or completion timestamp rewrite fails.

title: Concurrent erase across targets and workers
goal: Synchronize final link check and deletion completion under Postgres locking and lease CAS.
acceptance: Two erase events for same deletion receipt converge to one completion, both provider copies removed, correct outbox statuses.
negative_controls: No double completion and no premature DELETED while any copy remains.

title: Deferred quarantine supersession honored atomically
goal: When QUARANTINED successor is released ACTIVE, validate its recorded supersedes list and commit predecessor SUPERSEDED status and retire intents in same lifecycle transaction.
acceptance: Released successor and predecessor updates cannot diverge | failure leaves quarantined or explicit conflict, not coexistence.
negative_controls: Release cannot produce two active contradictory successor/predecessor records.

title: Historical state, restore and reproject contract
goal: Preserve bi-temporal history and reactivation receipts when lifecycle operations are repaired, without reintroducing v2 migration.
acceptance: Restore/retire/reproject work only from current canonical state with correct events and no duplicate provider facts.
negative_controls: Reactivation cannot resurrect deleted data or bypass consent.

title: PostgreSQL 16 transaction and race integration suite
goal: Run real Postgres two-worker leases, crash injection, rollback and synchronous health under intended server runtime.
acceptance: Atomicity, isolation, idempotency and one truthful outbox settle proved on exact source head.
negative_controls: No SQLite-only or in-memory-only green accepted for C1.

title: Full incoming-reference semantics
goal: Formalize whether protected links include references, supersedes, conflicts_with across tenant/namespace/state/time, without granting cross-tenant read.
acceptance: Policies specify exact source sets and target eligibility | no out-of-window reference is silently ignored.

title: Persisted incoming-reference count query
goal: Move reference enumeration from loaded in-memory slice into index-backed authorized store query for complete target set.
acceptance: Postgres counts every relevant incoming reference independent of watermark/limit/state and tenant-safe rules.
negative_controls: Beyond max_records and newer than watermark still counted.

title: Retention planner uses global reference evidence
goal: Pass authoritative counts to pure RetentionEngine, preserve pure planner and dry-run semantics.
acceptance: Referenced expired record soft-expires, unreferenced archives, both with inspectable decision receipts.
negative_controls: No archive of referenced record omitted from candidate slice.

title: Retention apply race/authorization proof
goal: Check reference snapshot or in-transaction guard against concurrent new reference while applying archive.
acceptance: Concurrent new incoming reference cannot be ignored by apply after dry-run decision | rejection/retry preserves state.
negative_controls: Late reference cannot be silently lost on archive.

title: Retention and maintenance full Postgres proof
goal: Use real Postgres with multiple namespaces and out-of-window references, prove replay and reports, no cross-tenant leakage.
acceptance: Source count, action, receipt and eventual projection retirement agree.
negative_controls: In-memory small-window tests alone cannot qualify retention.

title: Maintenance readout reflects required capability state
goal: Tie generated-data and scheduled maintenance readiness to actual selected backend health and source coherence.
acceptance: Unhealthy Postgres or active selected projection refuses false ready and emits degraded reason.
negative_controls: No static ready=true.

title: PostgreSQL-only canonical server and RLS isolation
goal: Make PostgreSQL 16 the only supported hosted canonical backend; create isolated database/role and verify tenancy policy and transaction-scoped claims.
acceptance: Any missing DSN/unreachable DB is fatal | no SQLite, ephemeral file, Zep or Neo4j silently promoted to canonical authority.
negative_controls: No fallback even when PG unavailable.

title: Postgres lifecycle adapter atomic persistence tests
goal: Make transaction-backed write, delete, link, receipt and lease operations conform to one service capability and lease invariant.
acceptance: Race and forced rollback produce no partial canonical state, including target-specific links.
negative_controls: Commit failure cannot leave link without receipt.

title: Remove production SQLite storage and old transaction path
goal: Full cutover removes SQLite serving and old local-memory instantiation; any sqlite tests retained only as archived source if useful.
acceptance: No production code can select SQLite canonical store | F-005/F-007 retired by reachability removal and negative tests.
negative_controls: SQLite connection logic not shipped in active server path.

title: Remove legacy deferred write queue and migration CLI
goal: No historical queue drain or migration promise; disable/delete old queue path instead of repairing REJECTED receipt drop.
acceptance: F-016 closed by removal, no pending-file loss in any live path, docs identify intentional non-migration.
negative_controls: No drain operation can delete a rejected record.

title: In-memory test adapter remains nonproduction only
goal: Keep deterministic disposable store for tests if needed, with shared retrieval and capability semantics; forbid hosting fallback.
acceptance: Conformance fixture cannot become production backend, source parity fixed with Postgres.
negative_controls: Test adapter not activated by bad DSN.

title: Secret model redaction and telemetry hygiene
goal: Avoid accidental credential leaks from MemorySettings repr/model_dump and CLI diagnostic errors; use proper secret-typed fields.
acceptance: DSN, graphiti token, zep key, Auth0 secrets never rendered in repr/log/response | test dangerous serialization.
negative_controls: Config show and exception messages never print DSN password.

title: Infisical rotation applied to active authenticators
goal: Either rebind authenticator/key+grant state atomically on refresh or require supervised restart with proof; environment reload alone is not proof.
acceptance: Rotated key and grants take effect within documented bound, with consistency and no auth bypass.
negative_controls: Old authenticator cache cannot silently ignore rotated secret.

title: Operational principal/env override lockdown
goal: Ensure L9_MEMORY_NAMESPACE and GRAPHITI_GROUP_ID cannot become remote claim authorities; old local selectors cannot influence OAuth principal.
acceptance: Remote namespace based solely on signed token claims plus server-side grant mapping | explicit local CLI is isolated.
negative_controls: No env namespace injection or auth-disabled admin drift.

title: Provider credentials and key lifecycle isolated by role
goal: Infisical project/machine identity can read only Memory service deployment secrets; OAuth is auth provider not secret store; Graphiti separate credentials.
acceptance: Secrets rendered to server env only with least privilege and rotation | no reuse of other C1 tenant secrets.
